preconditions.description: Attacker must have some balance of the target token to initiate transfer
Contract must not be paused (paused == false)
Attacker must not be blacklisted (isBlackListed[attacker] == false)

exploit_hint: The contract's transfer function has a fee calculation bug where it subtracts the full _value from sender's balance but only adds (value - fee) to recipient. This creates an inconsistency. Exploit by: 1. Ensure contract is not paused and you're not blacklisted. 2. Call transfer() with a value that triggers fee calculation (basisPointsRate > 0). 3. The fee will be minted to owner but the total supply doesn't increase accordingly, creating potential for balance inflation if owner transfers fees to attacker.
